world: Orange County-inspired open-world driving and life simulation

mode_summary.LOW: Nostalgic 16/32-bit arcade: saturated, clean pixel art, cheerful punchy UI, gameplay legibility first
mode_summary.HD: Naturalistic contemporary luxury: physically grounded materials, sunset/day/night, elegant restrained UX
mode_summary.ULTRA: Near-future premium sci-fi: silver/ice-blue signature OC hypercar, blue-white light accents, cinematic glass/metal UI

asset_naming: {MODE}-{SECTOR_2DIGITS}-{SHOT_4DIGITS}; generated files only if approved and validated

LOW.font_direction: blocky 8/16-bit pixel display headings with readable modern fallback for dense UI
LOW.style: pixel-art-inspired, hard step edges, simple high-contrast silhouettes

HD.font_direction: humanist/squared contemporary sans, restrained uppercase navigation
HD.style: natural glass/metal materials; believable asphalt, palm-lined streets, environmental light

ULTRA.font_direction: custom extended geometric sans, hairline tracking, strong information hierarchy
ULTRA.style: silver titanium, optical glass, micro-detail, refined icy-blue emissive accents

interface_guidelines.safe_area: minimum 5% horizontal and 6% vertical for vital gameplay readouts
interface_guidelines.hierarchy: world/vehicle remains dominant; UI at edges; legible at 1080p
interface_guidelines.dynamic_text: render headings/buttons in engine; do not depend on image-generator text
interface_guidelines.interaction: all controls require keyboard/controller mapping, focus, selected/hover states, accessibility
interface_guidelines.performance: avoid bloom washing out road signs and mirrors
interface_guidelines.readability: test at 1080p and 4K; adjust HUD scale

original_reference_resolution_warning: Generated boards are 1536 x 1024 and individual crops are lower-resolution. These are not native 4K assets.
